overview_description.description: Skymerse provides software that automates airline flight planning and operations control center activities. The company offers a platform that ingests schedules and continuously matches each flight against live NOTAMs, weather, runway constraints, aircraft limits, alternates, and company procedures to generate flight-ready decisions. Its tools present dispatchers and crews with operational impact assessments and recommended actions instead of raw documents. Skymerse also offers flight-ready intelligence via API for aviation platforms, using interpreted NOTAMs, structured aeronautical information publications, and client data sources. Its data platform incorporates automated NOTAM processing, data extraction agents, and an aeronautical decision model to support autonomous flight operations workflows.
